midSessionFindingsAndRulings.finding: cadRoll rails already in DEFAULT_SCHED_RAIL_KEYS (marketValue etc.) can show parcel_gate_verdict 'pass' from the engine's own parcel_record_cell model while the actually-served place_layer_snapshots.baseFacts.cadRoll reads unconditionally null -- nodeFacetBakeTier1Cli.ts bakes it null unconditionally and a separate dollar-fields-patch job, never run for any of the six counties, is the only thing that ever fills it. Separately, CTX-C found the propId-based join underlying that patch has a real integrity gap: Hays 45.2% (later full-run figure; sample was ~45%), Travis ~4.4% of joined rows land on a DIFFERENT property (situs-address cross-validated), which a naive row-exists check would silently fabricate as real dollar values.
midSessionFindingsAndRulings.thisLanesAction: Traced the causality: a pre-bake gate cannot express this, because the patch runs AFTER a bake and a fresh bake unconditionally re-nulls the field -- 'has the patch run before' is a question about a state the imminent bake is about to destroy. Declined to build a pre-bake check for it (would be either an always-false-blocker or a false-pass). Reported the full chain to doc-repo-26 rather than building around it or deciding it unilaterally.
midSessionFindingsAndRulings.ruling: doc-repo-26 confirmed the causality analysis was correct and ruled the fix IS this lane's to build -- but as a POST-condition (after bake-then-patch, baseFacts.cadRoll must carry real values wherever cad_property does and a declared absence otherwise; the publish run does not record success otherwise), fold dollar-fields-patch into the publish sequence so it stops being a step someone has to remember. HARD ORDERING CONSTRAINT, explicit: do not wire this until CTX-C's situs cross-check has landed and its six-county dry run comes back clean (Williamson's dry run was still in flight at time of writing). This lane has NOT built it this session, per that constraint -- see leave_behind for the exact unblock trigger.
